text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to working with you again 
starting today, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Did you have a good day off?
Did you have a good day off?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Since I had the chance, I tried my 
hand at a new dish. Chinese-style glazed 
sea bass, using carrots harvested in 
Funabashi.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Great taste, great nutrition, great 
Funabashi spirit. It's an energizing menu, 
so I'll treat you to some sometime, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seems Furioso got a solid rest!
